---
title: "SCNSim"
subtitle: "Superconducting Circuit Network Simulation"
---

SCNSim is being designed as a public Python package for auditable
superconducting-circuit network compilation, reduction, Direct/HB simulation,
optimization, and reporting.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Candidate semantics

The product, component-authoring, Runtime, Units, reduction, and failure semantics are `CONVERGING`.
They are not yet accepted, stabilized, implemented, released, or installable.
:::

## Review map

The [SCNSim V1 Component Authoring](component-authoring.qmd) and
[V1 Runtime Contract](v1-runtime-contract.qmd) pages divide the current product
authority without duplicating reusable physics. For Human review:

1. start with [one Library model](component-authoring.qmd#one-library-model)
   and [named electrical topology](component-authoring.qmd#named-electrical-topology);
2. review the [built-in leaves](component-authoring.qmd#built-in-leaves),
   [general composites](component-authoring.qmd#general-composites), and
   [six resonator factories](component-authoring.qmd#six-resonator-factories);
3. inspect the [finite-loop SQUID flux-pump example](component-authoring.qmd#finite-loop-squid-flux-pump-example)
   and its [Direct/HB realization](component-authoring.qmd#direct-and-hb-realization);
4. continue with the Runtime [review map](v1-runtime-contract.qmd#review-map)
   and [Notebook mental model](v1-runtime-contract.qmd#notebook-mental-model)
   for the lazy `NetworkViewRef` graph;
5. review [shared topology and solver-specific views](v1-runtime-contract.qmd#shared-topology-and-solver-specific-views)
   for selective Port-Termination Compensation (PTC), automatic floating-pair
   coordinates, arbitrary N-port retention, Direct/HB realization, and Pump-on
   authorization;
6. review [HB cases, traces, and display](v1-runtime-contract.qmd#hb-cases-traces-and-display)
   for multiple Pump-on conditions, exact case lookup, and matrix presentation;
   and
7. decide the two [open Human decisions](v1-runtime-contract.qmd#open-human-decisions)
   before implementation freezes their behavior.

The current [floating-qubit Ref-graph example](v1-runtime-contract.qmd#floating-qubit-ref-graph)
shows two-probe PTC, automatic common/differential coordinates, and a
probe-free feedline view without treating any of those operations as a second
circuit authority.

SCNSim keeps product/runtime behavior here and links outward for authoritative
circuit physics, consumer Design Targets, and private application evidence.
The shortest reusable physics path is
[floating-pair coordinates](https://github.com/arfiligol/SCQ_Design/blob/main/docs/knowledge/network-modeling/admittance-coordinate-transforms.qmd#full-external-cut-weighting)
→ [zero-current Schur reduction](https://github.com/arfiligol/SCQ_Design/blob/main/docs/knowledge/numerical-methods/schur-complement-kron-reduction.qmd#zero-current-schur-versus-matched-wave-submatrices)
→ [matrix-reference power waves](https://github.com/arfiligol/SCQ_Design/blob/main/docs/knowledge/simulation/port-reference-impedance-semantics.qmd#real-spd-matrix-reference-power-waves).

For component physics, use
[Josephson element models](https://github.com/arfiligol/SCQ_Design/blob/main/docs/knowledge/josephson-physics/josephson-current-phase-energy-and-inductance.qmd#josephson-model-contracts)
→ [finite-loop SQUIDs](https://github.com/arfiligol/SCQ_Design/blob/main/docs/knowledge/josephson-physics/dc-squid-flux-tunability.qmd#finite-loop-mutually-pumped-dc-squid)
→ [signed inductive coupling](https://github.com/arfiligol/SCQ_Design/blob/main/docs/knowledge/quantum-circuits/inductive-coupling-coefficient-mutual-self-inductance.qmd).
